roads.name: Cedar Island Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 14 curves in 3.0 miles.
From 1 to 8 ft, with 34 ft of up and down along the way.
Water alongside for stretches.
Homes line much of it: about 44 buildings a mile beside the road.
10 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 91°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.36 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
